note: #2767 item 6 (inline emphasis between the opening quote and the marker defeats the inverted-attribution check): isFollowedByFramingVerb still checks exactly one preceding character, not a scan through intervening Markdown emphasis. With "*Maintainer decision..." the character immediately before "Maintainer" is "*", which fails the quote-char check outright, so the real quote+attribution ("reports the tracking issue") is never checked. The gap is present today, verbatim as described (MATCH).
title: Choose option A for style
body:
Whether this design reads well is ultimately a matter of maintainer preference.

"*Maintainer decision (#100, 2026-09-01): choose option A,*" reports the tracking issue.
